inputs_used: content-system/personas/*.yaml (weights: planner_couple 0.40, funding_parent 0.20, uhnw 0.20, sceptic 0.10, search_visitor 0.10)

should_fix.issue: Key takeaways under-serve the keyword: three customs plus a cartório/notarial line, while the right-to-left ring move, names in the hem, the groom's tie and Santo Antônio are missing. search_visitor (brief's secondary persona) rated it medium; the brief reader wants to know what each custom means.
should_fix.r2_line: - Australians marrying in Brazil should confirm documents with the cartório first, then book any notarial appointment in Brasília or São Paulo, not Rio de Janeiro.
should_fix.fix: Keep exactly 4 takeaways, one sentence each, using only facts already in the body. Suggested: (1) Many couples wear the aliança on the right hand while engaged and move it to the left hand during the wedding. (2) Keep the padrinhos line as is. (3) Lighter customs include writing unmarried friends' names inside the bride's hem, cutting the groom's tie into keepsakes and handing bem-casados to guests as they leave. (4) Santo Antônio's June festivities add demand for transport and rooms, and a legal marriage in Brazil starts with the cartório, then any notarial appointment in Brasília or São Paulo. The current bem-casados and cartório takeaways fold into (3) and (4).

should_fix.issue: The legal hand-off line reads cold, and both the primary persona and funding_parent read it as a gap in what the Advisor does. It must not be replaced with any claim that the Advisor handles or helps with legal paperwork.
should_fix.r2_line: The legal steps above stay with you, the cartório and the Embassy.
should_fix.fix: Replace with a warmer neutral line and no paperwork claim, e.g. "For the legal side, the cartório and the Embassy remain your best guides." Leave the rest of the paragraph and the CTA unchanged.

should_fix.issue: No guest care for older or less mobile relatives in the travel section (transfers, step-free access, medical care). Raised by funding_parent and the primary persona.
should_fix.r2_line: - Travel insurance should cover medical costs, including evacuation.
should_fix.fix: After the Smartraveller list, add one line framed as questions only, reusing the existing Smartraveller facts: "If older or less mobile relatives are travelling, ask the venue or your planner about step-free access, transfer times and the nearest medical care, and check their travel insurance covers medical costs, including evacuation." No new facts, and no claim that the Advisor arranges it.

should_fix.issue: Dictionary attributions read stiffly in the custom sections (uni-essay feel). Keep the facts and markers, but lighten the phrasing.
should_fix.r2_line: Priberam also records the formal word paraninfo for the groom's padrinho.
should_fix.fix: Merge with the next sentence, e.g. "The groom's padrinho even has a formal name, paraninfo, so the honour is a witnessing role rather than a decorative one." Keep <!-- fact_09 -->. Similarly, "Michaelis also lists chá de cozinha, a kitchen tea, as another name for it." can become "It is also called chá de cozinha, a kitchen tea." with <!-- fact_04 --> kept. Keep at most one named dictionary per section.

consider.issue: 'Inclusions' edges towards package language for a large-family reader.
consider.r2_line: A Wedded Advisor is your single point of contact, with the fee agreed in writing before any work begins and inclusions confirmed in writing before you commit.
consider.fix: Swap 'inclusions' for 'scope' only if content-system/brand/brand-facts.md allows that wording; otherwise leave as is. Make no other Advisor claims.

keep: It says plainly which meanings are documented and which are simply often told. (praised by all five)
Treat everything below as a menu to discuss with both families, not a checklist that every wedding follows.
Because the role is formal, decide early who will sign as a legal witness at a civil ceremony and who will stand as an honorary padrinho.
Many couples wear their alianças on the right hand while engaged and move them to the left hand during the wedding.
The bem-casados explanation and the 'often told' framing of each meaning
FAQ cost answer with no invented figure: There is no single figure. Cartório fees are set locally...
The Smartraveller section with its dated advice level and the full advice link
Fee agreed in writing before any work begins (trust signal for funding_parent, sceptic and planner_couple)
conflicts_resolved: Title: planner_couple and search_visitor call it clickbait. The title is the person's choice, so it stays unchanged and is not an action item.

Business details (fee model, commissions, deposits, named Advisor, phone line, real weddings, 200 to 400 guest weddings, security, private transfers, privacy) were raised by 4 of 5 personas and would normally reach must_fix. They are deferred by instruction because no sourced facts exist; they go to open_questions, not the copy. No Advisor claims beyond brand-facts.md.

planner_couple (primary) asked the Advisor to cover legal timelines and appointments. Settled against: the Advisor is never described as helping with legal paperwork, so the fix is only a warmer neutral line.

Key takeaways: search_visitor wants the cartório line out, while funding_parent and planner_couple value the legal content. Settled for the brief's reader, who needs both: one takeaway keeps the legal step, and the rest name the customs.
Music and dance length (funding_parent, search_visitor): UNESCO facts are sourced and in the brief's angle, so no cut in this round.

checks.check: Weighted scores = sum(score x weight) / sum(weights), weights sum to 1.0
Every action quotes an exact 05-draft-r2.md line
No prices, fee figures or new unsourced facts in fixes
No Advisor paperwork claims; no 'from first idea to the last dance'
Max 5 action items; Australian English; no em dashes

open_questions.question: Fee model, commissions or mark-ups, and deposit protection for overseas suppliers: what can the post say? (sceptic, funding_parent)
Can the Advisor CTA name a phone call before booking, a named Advisor, or on-the-day contact? (funding_parent, planner_couple)

Is there a real Brazilian or Brazilian-family wedding (venue and date) we can link, and do we have large-wedding, security or private transfer experience in Brazil to cite? (planner_couple, uhnw, sceptic)
Weighted enquiry likelihood is 2.1 on a dreaming-stage post whose primary CTA is the magazine. Should the 3.8 gate be calibrated for top-of-funnel traditions posts (/wedded-calibrate)?

assumptions: Persona file names (hyphenated) map to ICP persona_ids (underscored).
Scores were read from payload.scores; likelihood_to_enquire comes from scores.likelihood_to_enquire.

The Key takeaways item is placed in should_fix despite a single mention because it comes from the brief's secondary persona, matches the primary keyword intent and was named in the brief for this round.
The gate is revise only on the enquiry threshold; must_fix is empty because business details are deferred.
